component: Worker queue admission and guarded metadata recovery orchestration

red.reason: Worker queue and recovery attempt APIs absent

validation.scope: worker_ filter, including two new recovery regressions across both builder pins
persistent retry across fresh claims and changed dependency regression, both builder pins

assertions: run_once selects distinct original-owner metadata work; actual managed-worker owner/bot/GitHub authorization is required before claiming. Selection is never a workflow lease or coding authority.

A shared protected metadata pass reconciles known pending effects first, imports known original-namespace completions and repairs publication before handoff, then settles readiness only under native writer-revocation and original input nonrelease proofs.

Reserved and unbound cases reach guarded readiness using their distinct native proof APIs. A replacement metadata claim after an already completed handoff revalidates the existing native frontier without inventing another handoff.

Live owner claims cannot be selected for takeover. Eligible expired recovery wakes the worker even when ordinary command eligibility is false; the wake hint does not mutate ownership and is repository scoped.
Queue selection preserves workflow state and uses the durable command attempt delay, age ordering and alternating automatic lane; ordinary peers remain eligible after a refused recovery attempt.
The real worker entry with missing owner/bot configuration refuses before a new claim; fixtures have no fixture-policy override to that entry.
Attempt completion is conditional on the original unfinished selection and cannot overwrite a prior terminal result. Recovery attempts do not use generic recipient progress projection.

Policy/capacity observation, selection and native metadata work run on blocking tasks outside the async executor; observations occur outside SQL/native locks. Unavailable preparation observation retains ordinary command selection.
Original body/model charge, checkpoint, controls, queued input and completed handoff context remain unchanged in the full metadata fixtures.
limits: Native body/resource setup is synthetic persisted state. Protected native/audit/SQL APIs are real; no VM/provider/model/body or live private message executes.
No normally deployed managed-worker positive admission, full live scheduler recovery or private productive coding acceptance is proven. The real worker-entry test exercises refusal only.
Recovery candidate scans are bounded to 64 rows per selection/wake. The durable selection cursor rotates on actual selection passes; beyond-window work can wait for the normal worker tick.
The normal outer loop still applies its existing merge-allowance dispatch gate. Metadata-only continuation at exhausted merge allowance needs separate consideration.
Private recovery retry/result delivery is deliberately not projected through a repository default recipient. The required original-conversation progress adapter remains incomplete.
Completion import from closed/transferred sources and unavailable post-commit lookup fault coverage remain incomplete.
Full C/R custody/resource/source/input qualification, legacy debt settlement and productive repeated successor/body/release/model/result cycles remain incomplete.
Worker filtered tests and ordinary queue tests preceded only a documentation-comment correction; the final persistent retry regression and non-test build use the final source.
Fresh combined-head hosted checks, exact-head independent review, rollout, CLI/Discord acceptance, five confirmed autonomous merges, 72h fault and 24h unattended soak are not proven.
